findings.observation: Tracked generated description index stores a local wall-clock stamp, and its generator is not a docs CI drift check.
findings.method: inspection of docs/02-architecture/diagrams/descriptions/INDEX.md:3, scripts/diagrams/render/generate_description_indexes.py:55-56 and :206-207, scripts/diagrams/render/generate_all_bundles.py:586 and :679; workflow search for those script names
findings.expected: Tracked generated docs are deterministic (no local now()) and regenerated output is checked in CI.
findings.actual: INDEX.md line 3 is `_Автогенерация: 2026-07-18T17:33:44+03:00_`. Generator uses `datetime.now().astimezone()` and `Path.write_text`. Sibling `docs/02-architecture/diagrams/bundles/architecture.bundle.md:3` is `Generated: 2026-07-18T18:29:11` from naive `datetime.now().strftime`. Neither script is invoked by `.github/workflows/docs.yml`.
findings.impact: Repeating the generator on an unchanged corpus rewrites tracked Markdown; CI will not fail that drift.
findings.remediation: Stamp from a fixed source (git commit date or SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH), normalize the stamp in `--check`, write via temp+os.replace, and call that check from docs CI.
findings.automation: CI check that regenerates indexes/bundles and diffs them with calendar stamps normalized

findings.observation: The canonical link gate and strict MkDocs build both ignore missing PNG/SVG targets.
findings.expected: Broken published image links fail `python -m scripts.docs verify` or the strict MkDocs build.
findings.actual: check-links continues when the target endswith `.png` or `.svg`. mkdocs `validation.links.not_found` is `info`. Job `render-diagrams` is `if: ${{ false }}`.
findings.impact: A Markdown href to a missing PNG/SVG can pass the docs verify chain. Bundle image existence is a separate architecture test, not this command.
findings.remediation: Fail check-links on missing local `.png`/`.svg` targets, or raise MkDocs `not_found` above info and keep a CI render/existence job that actually runs.
findings.automation: extend scripts.docs check-links and keep it in docs.yml validate-mkdocs

findings.observation: Packaged site build does not pass `--strict`, while the CI verification chain does.
findings.expected: `python -m scripts.docs build-site` matches the strict build used by `python -m scripts.docs verify` in CI.
findings.actual: `_mkdocs_build` runs `mkdocs build` plus caller args and does not add `--strict`. CI job `validate-mkdocs` runs `verify`, which adds `--strict --clean` into a temp site dir. README calls `build-site` a CI-style local smoke.
findings.impact: A local build-site success can hide warnings that fail the CI strict build.
findings.remediation: Default `build-site` to `mkdocs build --strict` unless the caller opts out.
findings.automation: unit test that the default argv contains --strict

findings.observation: mkdocstrings is enabled, but no docs page has a directive, so the strict build does not render the public API.
findings.method: inspection of mkdocs.yml:125-134; search of docs/**/*.md for mkdocstrings directives; tests/architecture/test_api_reference_public_facades.py:15-18 and :43-46; docs.yml docs-governance pytest list
findings.expected: CI either builds API reference from src via mkdocstrings or an equivalent check covers the published API surface.
findings.actual: Plugin paths point at `src`, and no `:::` handler directive exists under docs/. CI test `test_api_reference_public_facades.py` only checks backtick symbols in package-structure tables of application.md, composition.md, and infrastructure.md, and forbids an autogen claim.
findings.impact: API drift outside those three tables does not fail `mkdocs build --strict`.
findings.remediation: Add mkdocstrings directives for the published public surface, or drop the unused plugin and widen the facade test beyond the three tables.
findings.automation: architecture test that every nav API page is either mkdocstrings-backed or listed in the facade allowlist
